page0.text:
"See you, Shirou. I'll bring something home, so be good."
Fuji-nee waves as she heads out for work.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page0:1

page1.text: "I'm going to get going too. I need to swing by home, so I'll be a little late. I should be back by dinner, though. Don't do anything rash while everyone's gone."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page1:1

page2.text:
"...All right, then."
It's half past seven in the morning.
I see the two of them off without incident, so there's only one thing left to do now.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page2:1

page3.text:
"Okay, we're going to continue where we left off yesterday. Let's head to the dojo, Saber."
"Oh? Are we going to begin training right away? You have just eaten; perhaps it would be best to wait awhile."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page3:1

page4.text: "Don't worry about that. I've trained myself to the point where stuff like that doesn't affect me, and today's breakfast was bread, right? I don't live an unhealthy enough lifestyle for something like that to affect me."
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page4:1

page5.text:
"Hm. Well, if you insist, I do not mind."
"Good, then. Let's just go. I spent all night coming up with ways to get at least one hit in, so I want to show you the fruits of my labor."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page5:1

page6.text:
"...Ngh!!!"
I'm unable to dodge Saber's counterattack. Both the shinai and I tumble to the ground.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page6:1

page7.text:
"Hah! ...Kngh...!"
My fingers tingle where they grip the shinai.
Saber's counterattack lands as I lunge in with all my might. I'd figured brute force was my only option.
No shock that I dropped my shinai and fell right on my ass after an attack like that.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page7:1

page8.text:
"...Damn. I thought that would work."
"Shirou. Your expectations were unrealistic.
Listen. You will not be able to defeat a Servant simply by acting out of desperation. It is one thing to be determined, but you must first consider your opponent."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page8:1

page9.text: "Hm. That may be true, but I'll lose if I stay on the defensive. I have to strike if I find an opening."
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page9:1

page10.text: "That is true, but you do not understand how to properly utilize that opportunity. If you are to strike so desperately, you must wait for an appropriate opportunity."
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page10:1

page11.text: "That goes without saying. I saw you looking away for a brief second that last time. I've only seen you do that maybe one other time, so I thought it was my chance."
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page11:1

page12.text:
"I applaud you for noticing that and deciding to act, but I looked away deliberately.
I did so thinking it would not be sufficient to prompt you to move; I did not expect you to charge straight at me."
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page12:1

page13.text: "...Ugh. That's pretty mean, Saber. You shouldn't mock amateurs like that."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page13:1

page14.text:
"I was not mocking you. It was simply a ploy, and creating an opening such as that carries with it a degree of risk.
However, the risk I take by looking away and the risk you take by charging straight at me are simply not comparable."
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page14:1

page15.text: "Hm. So what you're saying is that I should be less obvious about seizing an opportunity? If I make a big, obvious attack, I'm squandering the opportunity... Erm, so you're saying I should be considering the opportunity and acting to suit it."
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page15:1

page16.text: "Yes. You must learn to judge the value of the opportunity you have."
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page16:1

page17.text: "However, I must point out that you are much better at discerning the boundaries between life and death than yesterday. As you develop a sense of danger, you will become more able to determine when to fight and strike on your own."
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page17:1

page18.text:
Saber looks pleased.
Unless it's my imagination, she seems happy to see her student improving a bit.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page18:1

page19.text:
"It is almost time to rest. Shall I fetch you some water, Shirou?"
"No need, as long as it's just water. I filled a whole kettle, so I'll just drink from that."
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page19:1

page20.text:
I drag my fatigued body towards the wall.
After wiping the sweat from myself with a towel I brought along, I take several gulps from the kettle.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page20:1

page21.text:
"...Phew."
I take a deep breath.
It's been almost three hours since I saw Tohsaka and Fuji-nee off. I've spent every minute since sparring with Saber.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page21:1

page22.text:
As usual, Saber doesn't explain much, and I don't ask her any questions while we cross swords.
I have pretty much no chance of winning, but I do seem to be moving better the more I fight Saber.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page22:1

page23.text:
I'm not expecting to improve my fighting techniques.
The point here is to train my body, not my mind, to get accustomed to battle.
It's better than doing nothing, and since I am starting from basically nothing, there wouldn't be much point here unless I spend time working on this one thing.
If all I do is think about how to fight when the time comes for me to face a Master, I'm dead.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page23:1

page24.text:
"Saber just doesn't even break a sweat, huh?"
I'm a little disappointed, but I shouldn't expect to be on her level in just a day or two.
And just like yesterday, Saber rests, seated in a seiza position.
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page24:1

page25.text:
"...Hm."
It'd be a waste to just sit here.
I might as well take the opportunity to talk with her.
Okay, then...
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-08:page25:1
